notes: Source: ARRI ALEXA 35 User Manual, SUP 1.1, May 2, 2023 (official ARRI documentation), corroborated by arri.com product page. Connector body count reflects the standard camera body without accessory modules (PDM-1 power distribution module, AEM-1 audio extension module, or MVF-2 viewfinder attached) — those add further I/O. LEMO/Fischer proprietary connector shells do not map exactly to the fixed connector-id list, so the closest generic analog was chosen and the true LEMO/Fischer part number is noted per port. VF1/VF2 (CoaXPress viewfinder ports, ARRI custom connector) and the White Radio / WiFi RP-SMA antenna connectors were omitted as they are not standard AV signal/power I/O types covered by the connector enum (no CoaXPress or RF-antenna id exists). SDI 2 is switchable in firmware between SDI output (up to 12G) and Return-In input (accepts 1.5G/3G) — modeled here as a bidirectional 12G-capable port. ETH is a LEMO 10-pin that carries standard Ethernet (breaks out to RJ45 via ARRI's KC 153-S cable) — modeled as rj45 bidirectional per the port-list convention, actual physical shell is LEMO. PWR (LEMO 8-pin, 20.5-33.6V DC input) has no exact match in the connector enum; mapped to dc-barrel as the closest "external DC input" analog, actual connector is LEMO EEJ.2B.308. 12V accessory output (LEMO 2-pin) and RS (Fischer 3-pin, 24V accessory power + shutter/remote-start control) are also proprietary shells mapped to dc-barrel as nearest analog. AUDIO port is a 6-pin LEMO carrying 2-channel balanced +24dBu line-level audio (like XLR3) plus 12V power sleeve — mapped to xlr3 with a note since it is not a standard XLR. TC is 5-pin LEMO carrying LTC in/out, mapped to bnc-adjacent rs232 is wrong; kept as closest control analog "ir" was rejected — used rs232 was also wrong, so left unset connector closest is none-perfect; see per-port note. USB-C is on the media bay for exFAT storage/data and charging (5V/1.5A out), not a display/AV port, included as bidirectional usb-c without a grade since spec does not state a USB generation.

ports.name: PWR
ports.note: Main DC power input, LEMO 8-pin (EEJ.2B.308), accepts 20.5-33.6 V DC via ARRI KC50-S/KC50-SP-S cables. Proprietary LEMO shell, not a true barrel connector.

ports.name: 12V
ports.note: Regulated 12.0 V accessory power output, 2.0 A max, LEMO 2-pin (EEG.0B.302). Proprietary LEMO shell.

ports.name: RS
ports.note: Regulated 24 V accessory power output, up to 3.0 A; also carries shutter pulse and remote start/stop signal. 3-pin Fischer connector (DBP102A052-130), proprietary shell.

ports.name: SDI 1
ports.note: Configurable: 422 1.5G HD / 3G HD, 444 3G HD, 422/444 6G-12G UHD per SMPTE ST 292-1, 425-1, 2081-10, 2082-10.

ports.name: SDI 2 / RET IN
ports.note: Switchable in-menu: functions as second 12G-SDI output (same formats as SDI 1) or as a Return-In input accepting 1.5G/3G SDI.

ports.name: SYNC IN
ports.note: Reference sync input; accepts analog black burst and tri-level HD sync signals for genlock. No SDI bandwidth grade applies (sync reference only).

ports.name: TC
ports.note: 5-pin LEMO (EEG.0B.305) accepting/outputting LTC (Longitudinal Timecode). Proprietary LEMO shell, not physically a BNC; mapped as closest control/signal analog since no LEMO id exists in the connector list.

ports.name: ETH
ports.note: 10-pin LEMO (EEG.1B.310) carrying Ethernet for remote control, metadata streaming, and service; supplies regulated 24 V/0.5 A. Breaks out to standard RJ45 via ARRI Ethernet Cable KC 153-S. Proprietary LEMO shell physically, not a native RJ45 jack.

ports.name: AUDIO
ports.note: 6-pin LEMO (EEA.0B.306.CLN), 2-channel +24 dBu balanced line-level audio input plus regulated 12 V/0.5 A power out. Proprietary LEMO shell, not a true XLR3; mapped as closest balanced-audio analog.

ports.name: SERIAL
ports.note: 4-pin LEMO (EEC.0B.304.CLN) for distance-measurement accessories (e.g. ARRI UDM-1); provides regulated 12.0 V/200 mA and serial data (RX/B, TX/A). Proprietary LEMO shell mapped as closest serial-control analog.

ports.name: LBUS (body)
ports.note: 4-pin LEMO (EEG.0B.304), CAN-based daisy-chainable lens/accessory control bus (ECS), supplies regulated 24.0 V/4.0 A. Proprietary LEMO shell mapped as closest differential-bus analog.

ports.name: LBUS (lens mount)
ports.note: Second LBUS connector located on the lens mount; identical spec to body LBUS. Do not daisy-chain both LBUS ports together per ARRI's manual warning.

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: In media bay; used for user setups, frame grabs, log files, software/LUT/frame-line updates via exFAT USB stick, and can charge USB devices at 5.0 V/1.5 A. Spec does not state USB generation/speed, so grade omitted.
